UK & European temperature controlled distribution
JHP Transport was founded in 2007 with a goal of providing the most reliable service – conscious, cost effective heavyweight forwarding within the transport industry.
With our customer centred focus, we have built successful long term partnerships with our clients, working to service their daily requirements and anticipate their future ones.
Starting from an office in Lanarkshire, Scotland, 16 years later JHP Transport has grown to be one of the largest logistics companies in Scotland.
We operate all over the UK and parts of Europe collecting full and part loads running them directly from collection to their delivery points.
Million miles covered every year by our E6 modern vehicles
By actively understanding our customers’ objectives and requirements, we strive to become an integral part of their operations.
We ensure that our response to what we hear goes beyond the ordinary by providing solutions that truly meet our customers’ needs, even if it requires thinking outside the box.
Through our commitment to innovation and expertise, we deliver highly flexible, consistent, and responsive service offerings that are among the best in the industry. This consistency not only meets our customers’ expectations but also adds significant value to their operations.
JHP Transport has grown to be one of the largest and most successful Heavy Transport and specialist Heavy Lift companies in the UK. As experts transport, heavy haulage, cargo transport, logistics, project management and much more, our experienced team of professionals understand the needs and expectations of our customers, and have the knowledge and expertise to overcome the daily challenges involved in delivering on time, and on budget.
Storage & Distribution
JHP Transport have been successfully providing warehousing and distribution services along with road haulage solutions, to businesses throughout the UK and Europe for over 16 years.
Based just outside Glasgow and situated with easy access to all major transportation routes, JHP Transport offers companies the perfect location for their warehousing and distribution requirements at competitive prices.
Chill & Ambient
Our expertise in transporting chilled, ambient & frozen goods put us in the forefront of refrigerated transport, leading to logistics & haulage awards. With over forty years experience in the haulage industry JHP Transport are one of the country’s leading providers of Ambient, Chilled and Frozen logistics solutions.
WHY JHP TRANSPORT?
We don’t think logistics should be boring we want to give amazing service to our customers and make the experience of working with us as enjoyable and stress free as possible.
Our expertise in transporting chilled & ambient cargo put us in the forefront of refrigerated transport, leading to logistics & haulage awards.
With over 16 years experience in the haulage industry JHP Transport are one of scotlands leading providers of Ambient, Chilled and Frozen logistics solutions.
Our customers can be confident that their supply chain is in safe hands and has the flexibility to change with their needs.
On Board CCTV systems helps eliminate blind spots and make manoeuvring safer. CCTV can help protect us and our customer goods we are transporting.
Vehicle tracking systems allow JHP Transport to monitor the exact location of every vehicle in our fleet in real time.
With fuel prices constantly on the rise, being more efficient with the fuel we use is essential. By monitoring our driver behaviour and the amount of fuel our fleet uses, our vehicle’s GPS tracker assists us with saving fuel and cutting costs. From optimising individual driving behaviour to monitoring efficiency across our fleet, our vehicle tracking systems give us all the tools to stay ahead.
Ensuring the productivity of your fleet is a very difficult and demanding task. Coupled with this is the burden of administration involved with owning and operating such a large vehicle fleet. Our Vehicle tracking systems automatically capture data on vehicle usage across our fleet, allowing us generate detailed and powerful reports at a click of a button.
Our Fleet telematics technology allows us to monitor the location, movement, status and behavior of any one of the vehicles within our fleet. This is achieved through a combination of a GPS receiver and an electronic GSM device that is installed in each vehicle, which then communicates with our staff in the office, providing them with detailed, accurate data.
Along with consistently delivering our day to day needs, the team at JHP are engaging and Innovative when we approach for assistance with ad hoc problems.
Every aspect of what the team do is delivered in an exceptionally professional manner, with communication and accurate information at the centre of this.
Their friendly and professional approach ensures we meet the demands and expectations of our customers on time, every time.
Haulage has seen some tough times in recent years, driven through the Covid Pandemic and inflated fuel rates, but JHP have remained dedicated to providing us with the best possible service ensuring the needs of our business are achieved.
The office team and drivers offer excellent communication, and a professional can do attitude.
Vehicles are well maintained and presented, after all first impressions are everything to a customer.
They are a professional company to work with and have always been very reliable and help out anyway they can.
